usage: benham.py conv [-h] {list,show,close,bank} ...

positional arguments:
  {list,show,close,bank}
    list                Conversations, live by default
    show                One conversation with its event log
    close               Shut the loop, with an outcome
    bank                Give up waiting, keep the question

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
